sources.title: YDS: Yabancı Dil Bilgisi Seviye Tespit Sınavı

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Mark, have you had a chance to look at the budget report I sent you yesterday?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's a relief. I was worried the figures for the marketing department looked too high.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: No, they're in line with what we agreed in March. I'll sign it off this afternoon.

options: Not yet, I'm afraid. I've been in meetings all day and haven't even opened my inbox.
Yes, I went through it last night, and everything seems to add up.
I did, but I think we need to cut the marketing budget by at least half.
Which report do you mean? I don't remember receiving anything from you.
I had a look, and honestly, the marketing figures are far too high.
items.explain_tr: Sarah'ın bir sonraki repliği 'Rahatladım' ([en:That's a relief]) diyor ve Mark en sonda rakamların uygun olduğunu söylüyor; yani boşluğa olumlu bir değerlendirme gelmeli. B bunu veriyor. A ve D'de rapor okunmamış, 'rahatladım' tepkisi anlamsız kalır; C ve E'de Mark rakamları fazla buluyor, oysa son replikte tam tersini söylüyor.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Professor Hayes, I'd like to talk to you about the deadline for the research proposal.

lines.speaker: Professor Hayes
lines.text: Of course, Tom. Is there a problem with the timeline?

lines.speaker: Professor Hayes
lines.text: I see. In that case, I can give you until the end of next week, but no later.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Thank you, that would be a great help. I'll have it ready by then.

options: No problem at all. I've already submitted it to the department office this morning.
Actually, I was wondering whether I could change my topic to something completely different.
Not really, but I wanted to ask which referencing style you prefer for the bibliography.
Yes. The library has been closed for a week, so I couldn't access some of the key sources.
I'd rather hand it in early, if that's possible, since I'll be away for most of next month.
items.explain_tr: Profesör 'Anlıyorum, o hâlde sana gelecek haftanın sonuna kadar süre verebilirim' diyor; demek ki Tom bir gecikme nedeni anlatmış olmalı. D (kütüphane kapalıydı) bunu sağlıyor. A'da teklif zaten teslim edilmiş, ek süreye gerek yok; E'de Tom erken teslim etmek istiyor, uzatma cevabı buna uymaz; B ve C konuyu değiştiriyor.

lines.speaker: Dr. Collins
lines.text: Good morning, Mr. Baker. What seems to be the trouble?

lines.speaker: Mr. Baker
lines.text: I've had a persistent cough for about three weeks now, and it's getting worse at night.

lines.speaker: Dr. Collins
lines.text: Have you been running a temperature or noticed any shortness of breath?

lines.speaker: Dr. Collins
lines.text: Then we'd better do a chest X-ray today, just to rule out an infection in the lungs.

options: No fever, but I do get out of breath when I climb the stairs at home.
Not at all, and to be honest the cough is almost gone now anyway.
I've been taking some cough syrup my wife bought at the pharmacy.
Yes, I already had an X-ray at another clinic last week, and it was clear.
I'd rather not have any tests done today, if that's all right with you.
items.explain_tr: Doktor ateş ve nefes darlığı soruyor, sonra 'O hâlde ([en:then]) bugün akciğer filmi çekelim' diyor; yani hasta endişe verici bir belirti bildirmiş olmalı. A (nefes darlığı var) buna uyuyor. B'de belirti yok ve öksürük geçiyor, film çekme kararı mantıksız kalır; D'de film zaten çekilmiş ve temiz çıkmış; C soruyu yanıtlamıyor; E testi reddediyor.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Excuse me, is this the right platform for the 10:15 train to Manchester?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Oh no, I had no idea. Is there another train I could take this morning?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, the next one leaves from platform 6 at 11:05, and your ticket will still be valid.

options: Yes, it is. The train should be arriving in about five minutes, so you're just in time.
I'm afraid I don't work here. You'd better ask at the information desk over there.
It's platform 6, just across the bridge, but there's no rush; it isn't due for another twenty minutes.
Tickets for Manchester can only be bought at the ticket office upstairs, not on the train.
It was, but I'm afraid that service has been cancelled because of a signal failure.
items.explain_tr: Emma 'Olamaz, hiç bilmiyordum. Başka bir tren var mı?' diyor; demek ki görevli kötü bir haber (trenin iptali) vermiş. E bunu söylüyor. A ve C'de trene yetişmek hâlâ mümkün (tren geliyor ya da vakit var), 'başka tren var mı' sorusu anlamsız olur; B'de görevli burada çalışmadığını söylüyor ama sonra ayrıntılı bilgi veriyor; D bilet satışından söz ederek konuyu değiştiriyor.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: Hi George, I'm sorry to bother you, but the noise from your garden last night went on until well after midnight.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: Oh, I'm really sorry about that. It was my daughter's birthday and things got a bit out of hand.

lines.speaker: George
lines.text: Of course. I'll make sure everyone's inside by ten next time, and I'll let you know in advance.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: Thanks, I appreciate that. Enjoy the rest of your weekend.

options: That's no excuse. I'm going to report it to the council first thing on Monday morning.
Happy birthday to her! How old is she now, by the way? She's grown so much.
It happens. Could you just keep it down after ten in future, and maybe warn me beforehand?
Don't worry, I didn't hear a thing. I was away for the whole weekend anyway.
Actually, I was wondering if you could lend me your lawnmower this weekend.
items.explain_tr: George 'Tabii ([en:Of course]). Gelecek sefer herkes onda içeride olur, önceden de haber veririm' diyor; yani Linda saat ve önceden haber verme konusunda bir ricada bulunmuş. C tam bu ricayı yapıyor. A'da Linda belediyeye şikâyet edeceğini söylüyor, 'tabii' cevabı buna uymaz; D ilk replikle çelişiyor (gürültüyü duymuş); B ve E konuyu değiştiriyor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello, I ordered a laptop from your website two weeks ago, and it still hasn't arrived.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you give me your order number so I can check the status?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's 48213. I've already emailed twice, but nobody replied.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tomorrow would be fine, as long as someone is actually going to deliver it this time.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: I'll put a note on the order so the courier calls you before they come.

options: Sorry about that. The parcel was sent back to our warehouse by mistake, so we can resend it tomorrow or on Thursday.
I can see that the parcel was delivered last Monday and signed for by one of your neighbours.
Unfortunately, that model is out of stock at the moment and we have no idea when it will be available again.
I'm afraid I can't find any order under that number on our system. Are you sure you've read it correctly?
Would you prefer to cancel the order altogether and receive a full refund to your card within five days?
items.explain_tr: Rachel 'Yarın olur, yeter ki bu sefer gerçekten teslim edilsin' diyor; demek ki Kevin yeni bir teslimat günü seçeneği sunmuş. A bunu yapıyor. B'de paket zaten teslim edilmiş görünüyor, 'yarın' cevabı anlamsız; C'de ürün stokta yok, teslimat teklif edilemez; D sipariş bulunamıyor; E iptal ve iade öneriyor, Rachel'ın 'yarın teslim' cevabı buna uymaz.

lines.speaker: Ms. Turner
lines.text: Your CV says you left your last position after only six months. Could you tell me why?

lines.speaker: Ms. Turner
lines.text: That's understandable. Relocation can be difficult. So you're settled in the city now?

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Yes, I moved here in January, and I'm looking for something long term.

options: I'd rather not discuss my previous employer in detail, if you don't mind.
Actually, I'm still working there, but I'm looking for a position with a better salary.
The company went bankrupt, so all of us were made redundant at the same time.
My wife was offered a job in this city, so we decided to move, and I couldn't continue from here.
To be honest, I didn't get on with my manager and the atmosphere became quite tense.
items.explain_tr: Görüşmeci 'Anlaşılır bir şey, taşınmak ([en:relocation]) zor olabilir' diyor; yani James işten ayrılma nedeni olarak taşınmayı anlatmış olmalı. D bunu veriyor. C (iflas) ve E (yöneticiyle anlaşmazlık) gerçek nedenler ama taşınmayla ilgisi yok; B'de James hâlâ orada çalışıyor, oysa görüşmeci 'ayrıldın' diyor; A soruyu yanıtsız bırakıyor.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Have you heard that the company is planning to move to a four-day working week next year?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Yes, Helen mentioned it at lunch. I'm not sure how I feel about it, to be honest.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: That's exactly my worry. We'd probably end up doing the same amount of work in fewer hours.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, let's wait and see what the details are before we make up our minds.

options: I think it's a great idea. We'll finally have some proper time for our families.
Nor am I. I suspect the workload won't shrink just because the week does.
Really? I hadn't heard anything about it. When did they announce it?
Helen always knows everything before the rest of us, doesn't she?
As long as my salary stays the same, I honestly don't mind what they decide.
items.explain_tr: Nina 'Benim endişem de tam bu; aynı işi daha az saatte yapmak zorunda kalırız' diyor; yani Paul iş yükünün azalmayacağı endişesini dile getirmiş. B bunu söylüyor. A'da Paul fikri çok beğeniyor, 'benim endişem de bu' cevabı uymaz; E'de endişe maaşla ilgili, iş yüküyle değil; C konuyu Paul'un kendisi açtığı için çelişkili; D konuyu değiştiriyor.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Hi Ben, are you going to the lecture on climate policy this afternoon?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I'd like to, but I have a tutorial at the same time and I can't miss it.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: That's a shame. It's the last one in the series, and the speaker is supposed to be excellent.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Sure, I'll take plenty of notes and send them to you tonight.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Thanks, that's really kind of you.

options: Never mind. I've already read most of her papers, so I won't miss much.
Maybe I should skip the tutorial after all. It's only revision anyway.
Do you know whether the lecture will be recorded and put online afterwards?
Who is the speaker, by the way? I don't think you've mentioned the name.
I know. Would you mind letting me know afterwards what she says about carbon taxes?
items.explain_tr: Olivia 'Tabii, bol bol not alır, akşam sana gönderirim' diyor; bu, Ben'in dersin içeriğini aktarmasını rica etmesine verilen cevap. E bu ricayı yapıyor. C'de Ben kaydın olup olmadığını soruyor; cevap evet/hayır olmalı, not alma teklifi buna uymaz; A'da Ben dersi önemsemiyor, nota gerek yok; B'de dersi kendisi dinlemeyi düşünüyor; D konuşmacının adını soruyor.

lines.speaker: Dr. Patel
lines.text: Your blood test results are back, Mrs. Green, and your cholesterol is quite a bit higher than it should be.

lines.speaker: Dr. Patel
lines.text: Not necessarily. If you change your diet and exercise more, we can check again in three months before considering medication.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: All right, I'd much rather try that first.

options: That's wonderful news, doctor. I was so worried before I came in today.
I knew it. My mother had exactly the same problem when she was my age.
Does that mean I'll have to start taking tablets for the rest of my life?
Could the laboratory have mixed up my results with someone else's?
I'd like to start on the strongest medication you can give me right away.
items.explain_tr: Doktor 'Şart değil ([en:Not necessarily]). Beslenme ve egzersizle üç ay sonra tekrar bakarız, ilacı sonra düşünürüz' diyor; yani hasta ilaç kullanmak zorunda kalıp kalmayacağını sormuş. C bu soruyu soruyor. E'de hasta hemen ilaç istiyor, 'şart değil' cevabı buna uymaz; D'de sonuçların karışıp karışmadığı soruluyor, doktorun diyet önerisi buna cevap olmaz; A iyi haber sanıyor; B'ye 'şart değil' denmez.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Good evening, welcome to the Riverside Hotel. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: Yes, under the name Michael Reed, for three nights, a double room with a river view.

lines.speaker: Michael
lines.text: That's disappointing. In that case, could you at least give me a discount on the room rate?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Certainly, I can take twenty percent off for the inconvenience, and you'll have the view from tomorrow night.

options: Here's your key card, sir. Room 412 overlooks the river, exactly as you requested when you booked.
I'm sorry, we have no record of a booking in that name. Could it have been made under another name?
Would you like to pay for the room now, or would you rather settle everything at the end of your stay?
I've found your booking, but all the river view rooms are taken tonight, so you'd have a city view for the first night.
Breakfast is served from seven until ten in the restaurant on the ground floor, just past the lifts.
items.explain_tr: Michael 'Hayal kırıklığı. O hâlde en azından oda ücretinde indirim yapar mısınız?' diyor ve resepsiyonist 'manzarayı yarın akşamdan itibaren alırsınız' diye ekliyor; yani sorun yalnızca ilk gece manzaranın olmaması. D bunu açıklıyor. A'da her şey yolunda, hayal kırıklığı anlamsız; B'de rezervasyon bulunamıyor, 'o hâlde indirim' ve 'yarın manzara' buna uymaz; C ve E konuyla ilgisiz.

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: Morning, Judy. I noticed a van outside your house yesterday. Are you moving out?

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: Oh, that explains it. Well, if you need any help carrying things upstairs, just knock.

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: That's very kind. I might take you up on it this weekend.

options: No, nothing like that. My son is moving back in, and he brought all his furniture with him.
Yes, we're leaving on Friday. The house has finally been sold after all these months.
What van? I was away all day yesterday and didn't see anything outside.
I'd rather not talk about it, Alan, if you don't mind. It's a long story.
Actually, I was going to ask whether you'd seen my cat. She's been missing since Tuesday.
items.explain_tr: Alan 'Şimdi anlaşıldı. Eşyaları yukarı taşımak için yardım lazım olursa kapımı çal' diyor; yani Judy kamyonetin nedenini açıklamış ve eve eşya giriyor. A (oğlu eşyalarıyla geri taşınıyor) buna uyuyor. B'de Judy taşınıp gidiyor, 'yukarı taşımak' ve hafta sonu yardım buna uymaz; C'de açıklama yok, 'şimdi anlaşıldı' denemez; D ve E konuyu kapatıyor ya da değiştiriyor.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Thank you for calling Northern Energy. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I've just received my electricity bill, and it's almost double what I paid last month.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: No, I haven't. It's been exactly the same two people living here all year.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: In that case, the increase is probably due to an estimated reading. Could you read the meter for me now?

options: I'm sorry, but bills are calculated automatically and there's nothing we can do about it.
Would you like to switch to our monthly direct debit plan to spread the cost?
I see. Have you had any guests staying with you, or has anyone new moved in recently?
Prices went up by thirty percent in October, so most customers have seen a similar increase.
Could you confirm your account number and the address the bill was sent to?
items.explain_tr: David 'Hayır, olmadı ([en:No, I haven't]). Bütün yıl aynı iki kişi yaşıyor' diyor; yani Sophie evde yaşayan kişi sayısıyla ilgili bir evet/hayır sorusu sormuş. C bu soruyu soruyor. E'de hesap numarası isteniyor, 'hayır, olmadı' cevabı uymaz; B'de ödeme planı soruluyor, kişi sayısıyla ilgisi yok; A ve D soru değil, açıklama; sonraki 'o hâlde tahmini okuma' çıkarımı da onlara uymaz.

lines.speaker: Mr. Owen
lines.text: Thank you for coming in, Laura. Before we finish, is there anything you'd like to ask us?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Yes, I'd like to know what a typical first month in this role would look like.

lines.speaker: Mr. Owen
lines.text: You'd spend the first two weeks shadowing a senior analyst, and then you'd gradually take on your own clients.

lines.speaker: Mr. Owen
lines.text: Not at all. Most people are given their first full project by the end of the second month.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: That's reassuring. It sounds like a well-structured start.

options: That sounds perfect. I did a lot of shadowing in my previous job, so I'm used to it.
Would the senior analyst be the same person who interviewed me earlier today?
What kind of clients does the company mainly work with at the moment?
How many analysts are there in the team at the moment, and how is the work shared out?
I see. Would I be expected to handle clients entirely on my own after only a month?
items.explain_tr: Mr. Owen 'Hiç de değil ([en:Not at all]). Çoğu kişiye ilk tam proje ikinci ayın sonunda verilir' diyor; yani Laura, bir ay sonra müşterileri tek başına yönetmesinin beklenip beklenmediğini sormuş ve cevap 'hayır, o kadar erken değil' demek. E bu soruyu soruyor. B evet/hayır sorusu olsa da 'hiç de değil' ve 'proje verilir' bilgisi ona cevap olmaz; C ve D bilgi sorularıdır, onlara 'hiç de değil' denmez; A soru değil, yorum.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: Chris, the client has just called. They want the presentation moved from Friday to tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: I know it's tight, but they're deciding between us and another agency, so we can't say no.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.text: Fine. Then let's get the whole team together now and divide up the slides.

options: Great, that gives us two extra days to polish the slides properly.
Tomorrow? That's impossible. Half the figures aren't even ready yet.
Which client? I'm not working on any presentations this week.
No problem, the presentation has been ready since Monday afternoon.
Did they say why they changed their minds about the date?
items.explain_tr: Hannah 'Biliyorum, süre dar ([en:I know it's tight]) ama hayır diyemeyiz' diyor; yani Chris sürenin yetmeyeceğine itiraz etmiş. B bu itirazı yapıyor. A'da Chris ek süre kazandıklarını sanıyor (tarih öne alındı, ertelenmedi); D'de sunum hazır, 'süre dar' uyarısı anlamsız; E bir soru soruyor, Hannah cevap vermiyor; C konuyu bilmiyor.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Dr. Shaw, I got my essay back, and I don't really understand why I lost so many marks.

lines.speaker: Dr. Shaw
lines.text: Let's have a look. Your argument is clear, but most of your sources are from websites rather than academic journals.

lines.speaker: Dr. Shaw
lines.text: That's a fair point, but the library gives you free online access to all the major journals in the field.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I didn't know that. I'll make sure I use them for the next assignment.

options: Does that mean I'll be able to resubmit the essay for a higher mark before the end of term?
I see. So you'd like me to use fewer sources in total next time, rather than more?
The problem is that most journal articles are behind a paywall, and I can't afford them.
I spent weeks on that essay, so I honestly think the mark is quite unfair.
Could you recommend a few good books on the topic instead, so I know where to start?
items.explain_tr: Dr. Shaw 'Haklı bir nokta ama kütüphane sana bütün önemli dergilere ücretsiz erişim sağlıyor' diyor; yani Amy dergilere ulaşmanın ücretli olduğundan yakınmış. C bunu söylüyor. A ve E birer soru; 'haklı bir nokta' ve ücretsiz erişim cevabı onlara uymaz; B kaynak sayısını yanlış anlıyor; D'de not adaletsiz deniyor, erişim bilgisi buna cevap değil.

lines.speaker: Mr. Lewis
lines.text: Excuse me, I think there's been a mistake. Someone is sitting in my seat, 14C.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Let me check your boarding pass, sir. Ah, you're booked on the earlier flight to Lisbon, which has already departed.

lines.speaker: Mr. Lewis
lines.text: What? But I was at the gate twenty minutes before the time printed on my ticket.

lines.speaker: Mr. Lewis
lines.text: I see. Then I'll have to speak to someone at the desk about getting on this one.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I'll call ahead so they know you're coming. Please follow me.

options: The gate for that flight was moved and closed early, I'm afraid, and this plane is a later service.
Don't worry, sir. There's a free seat at the back of the cabin, so you can stay on this flight.
Please take seat 14C, sir. The passenger sitting there has the wrong boarding pass, not you.
That's correct, sir. This is your flight, and 14C is the seat you were assigned at check-in.
The seatbelt sign is on, sir, so I must ask you to sit down in any free seat for now.
items.explain_tr: Mr. Lewis 'Anlıyorum. O hâlde bu uçağa binebilmek için bankodakilerle görüşmem gerekecek' diyor; yani Grace durumu açıklamış ve bu uçakta yerinin olmadığı anlaşılmış. A bu açıklamayı veriyor. B, C ve D'de yolcu bu uçakta kalabiliyor, bankoya gitmesi gereksiz; E yalnızca oturmasını istiyor, 'anlıyorum' ve banko kararı buna uymaz.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: Did you get the letter from the council about the new parking restrictions on our street?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Yes, it came this morning. Permits only from next month, and only one per household.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Same here. I've no idea where my daughter is going to park when she visits.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: Maybe we should both write to the council and ask for visitor permits.

options: You're lucky you've got a garage, Steve, so it won't make any difference to you at all.
I haven't received anything yet. Could you show me your copy of the letter later today?
Will the permits be free, or do we have to pay for them every year like people in town?
I heard they're going to put up the new signs by the end of the week, probably on Friday.
That's a real problem for us. We've got two cars and nowhere else to put the second one.
items.explain_tr: Steve 'Bizde de öyle ([en:Same here]). Kızım ziyarete gelince nereye park edecek bilmiyorum' diyor; yani Karen kendi park sorununu anlatmış olmalı. E bunu yapıyor. A'da Karen kendi durumundan değil Steve'in durumundan söz ediyor, 'bizde de öyle' buna cevap olamaz; B ilk replikle çelişiyor (mektubu alıp almadığını kendisi sormuştu); C soru soruyor; D bir haber veriyor, kişisel bir sorun değil.

lines.speaker: Dr. Morgan
lines.text: I'd like you to come back in two weeks so we can see whether the new medication is working.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Two weeks? I'll be abroad for most of the month for work.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That would be ideal. I'll have internet access everywhere I'm going.

lines.speaker: Dr. Morgan
lines.text: Good. My secretary will send you the link and the instructions this afternoon.

options: Then you'll have to postpone the trip. This is far more important than work.
In that case, we can simply stop the medication until you return.
Could you ask a doctor abroad to check your blood pressure instead?
In that case, we could do the follow-up as a video consultation instead.
Make sure you take the tablets with food, especially while you're travelling.
items.explain_tr: Tom 'İdeal olur. Gideceğim her yerde internet var' diyor ve doktor 'bağlantıyı ([en:link]) gönderecek'; yani çevrim içi bir görüşme önerilmiş. D bunu öneriyor. C'de yurt dışında bir doktora görünmesi öneriliyor, internet ve bağlantı buna uymaz; A seyahati ertelemesini istiyor; B ilacı kesiyor; E tavsiye veriyor, hiçbiri 'internet erişimim var' cevabını gerektirmez.

lines.speaker: Nathan
lines.text: Hi, I bought these headphones here last week, and the left side has already stopped working.

lines.speaker: Nathan
lines.text: I'm afraid I threw it away with the packaging. But the purchase should be on my card statement.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: That's fine. If you can show me the transaction on your banking app, I can process an exchange.

options: I'm sorry, but we don't accept returns on electronic items once they've been opened.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you still have the receipt?
Have you tried charging them fully before using them?
Would you prefer a refund or a replacement pair?
Did you buy them in this branch or from our online store?
items.explain_tr: Nathan 'Maalesef onu ambalajla birlikte attım; ama alışveriş kart ekstremde görünür' diyor; yani Zoe fişi ([en:receipt]) sormuş. B bu soruyu soruyor.
